title: Does this look like a game you would play?
author: mjkoskinen
selftext:
A couple week ago I posted a preview of my space RPG game; exodus protocol. I got some feedback about the graphics not being up to snuff. After countless revisions, here's my second take at a trailer. Honest construct feedback appreciated!

I've had the idea for this game for years and I'm finally making it a reality. It is a cozy pixel-art space themed RPG. The concept is that humans are evacuating earth to live on mars and search out other plants. The player will make difficult decisions and face the consequences. Get lost in side missions or focus on the main ones depending on your preference. Combat is turn based with dodge/attack timers.

Developed using opus 5.5, no game engine, all art is procedural and it runs in the browser. A free playable demo will be coming soon.

comments.author: CashFirm573
comments.body: I honestly like it, the feedback I can give you and I know seems like you worked on it is artwork, biggest issue I see is nothing feels grounded, items feel like you pasted it on top and honestly I'm having same issues. Also tree's need little work they aren't how you do pixel art, same with the water. AI has bad habit of over engineering the colors, but outside that ya done great job you can see work you put into it. I would also look at changing font family and careful with outline brackets on boxes AI loves doing that to every single UI design. People will see it and go oh it's AI... even know it is, but we don't want to feel like everyone else right. Oh and the grass, I would look up few games and check how they did it.
